description: Curated 15-question intake for the Presentation Interview app. Every question id, prompt, kind, allowed_values, value_labels and storeOn is derived from the canonical 23-ai-workforce-blueprint/templates/role-library/presentations/intake/deck-intake-questions.json (v1.6.0) so the bridge can replay each answer through deck-intake-driver.py and the dept's _chk_intake provenance gate passes. Custom capture questions (logo, image_links) carry their own ids but are mapped to deck_brief fields by intake_writer.py. Cap 20; this set is 15. Progress label is 'Question N of 15'. presentation_type (order 0, allowed_values/value_labels mirrored from deck-intake-questions.json's legacy_field_mapping) is asked first and required -- it is the ONE answer that legitimately determines deck_type/creation_mode/presentation_mode/audience_mode downstream (see intake_writer.py's LEGACY_FIELD_MAPPING); the app must never fabricate a default for it. FIX-PITCH-ANTI-FAB (v1.1.0): added named_methodology (order 1.5) and time_to_result (order 2.5) -- unconditional, required questions the bank added at v1.6.0 so pitch_engines_check.py's AF-NO-BRANDED-METHOD / AF-NO-TIME-TO-RESULT anti-fabrication gates, which read intake.json's root named_methodology/time_to_result directly, no longer auto-fail every deck built through this app for lack of a capture question. intake_writer.py's _promote_anti_fabrication_fields() lands both at intake.json's TRUE ROOT regardless of which storeOn section they arrive through.

questions.prompt: What kind of presentation do you need?
questions.help: This is the first thing we need to know — it decides how we build everything else in your brief, from structure to length. Pick the one that fits.

value_labels.from_scratch: From scratch — we brainstorm your topic and build a brand-new presentation
value_labels.content_personal: From something I already have, made for ONE specific person
value_labels.content_general: From something I already have, made for a room or wider audience
value_labels.signature: The full Signature Presentation — a longer, multi-part keynote (100+ slides)

questions.prompt: What are you SELLING at the end — the exact name of the product or offer?
questions.help: The OFFER sold at the end of the presentation — never invented.

questions.prompt: Do you have a named methodology, framework, or system you deliver this through — what is it called, in your own words?
questions.help: The BRANDED METHOD name — client-supplied only, never invented for you. If you don't have a named method, say so plainly (e.g. 'no formal name, we just do X') rather than inventing one — an honest 'no' is still a real answer.

questions.prompt: What's the before-and-after this offer delivers — who are they before, and who are they after?
questions.help: The transformation promise drives the whole arc. Example: 'stuck and overwhelmed' to 'clear, confident, and closing'.

questions.prompt: How long does it typically take a client to see this result once they start — the real, honest timeframe?
questions.help: State the true delivery timeframe in your own words (e.g. '8 weeks', 'about 3 sessions', or 'it varies, typically N weeks') — never a faster number to sound more impressive.

questions.prompt: Who is this presentation for? Tell us about your audience — the pain point that brought them here.
questions.help: Industry, income level, and the specific pain that brought them. This seeds the audience-engine.

questions.prompt: What is the exact call-to-action — the specific verb and next step you want them to take?
questions.help: Example: 'book a call', 'buy the program', 'join the waitlist'. This drives the closing slide.

questions.prompt: Do you have a logo or brand colors you want on the slides?
questions.help: If no logo is on file, provide one here or we build without one and stay on-brand to the presentation system.

questions.prompt: Paste any image links you want used in the deck. (Optional — add up to 5.)
questions.help: Product photos, headshots, brand imagery. We source images through the approved image pipeline; links here are used as grounded references.

questions.prompt: Pick a tone — Inspirational, Tough Love, Challenger, Teacher, Storyteller, High-Energy Hype, or Calm Premium. You can also blend two.
questions.help: One of the seven named styles, or a blend of two.

questions.prompt: What is the final price of the offer?
questions.help: The OFFER price only — what a buyer pays at the end. Set 0 only if this is a free-only close.

questions.prompt: At what pace should we record the audio narration?
questions.help: default = our recommended setting (1.25), medium = 1.3, fast = 1.33.

questions.prompt: Do you need me to create a sales page and a checkout page to go along with your presentation?
questions.help: Default YES. A 'no' records a client waiver — you keep the deck and optionally a VSL page.

value_labels.yes: Yes, build the sales page and checkout page

questions.prompt: Would you like a VSL page — a video sales letter page — to go along with this?
questions.help: Default NO — a VSL page needs the video to exist first. Say yes only if a hosted video is in scope.

questions.prompt: Anything else important we should know before we start?
questions.help: Extras: target slide count, deadline, proof assets, or anything else. Optional.
